referenceFunction.generalComment: This is an example for the production of boxes out of corrugated board. The user can establish himself further boxes based on the information in this step.; UUID: 4df85d33-beb5-34f3-8e21-2af32c6ed093
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes the production of boxes out of corrugated board. It contains the steps of cutting, folding and printing. Besides the input of corrugated board, inks and glues are considered as well as the electricity consumption.
referenceFunction.localName: Packaging, corrugated board, mixed fibre, single wall, at plant
referenceFunction.name: Packaging, corrugated board, mixed fibre, single wall, at plant

geography.text: Estimation based on average data from European producers, collecte from FEFCO

representativeness.extrapolations: In FEFCO only a combined board and box production is show. For this study this has been split into two different datasets.
